data.name: THE LAST LOGIN
data.detailed_description:
THE LAST LOGIN is a narrative hacker thriller about desperation, bad choices, and the voice in your head that says it can help.

You lost your job. Rent is due. Your bank account is empty. Then the voice comes back — sharp, funny, dangerous — pushing you toward one small crime that could fix everything.

At first, it is just food. Then rent. Then bigger jobs. Then people start noticing.

Inside GHOST//OS, your in-game computer system, you will chat with dangerous contacts, inspect fake websites, use fictional terminal commands, compare intercepted responses, and make choices that quietly shape your future. Every action leaves a trace.

Key Features

  • Narrative hacker thriller set inside a dark apartment and the GHOST//OS computer system.

  • A mysterious voice in your head that guides, jokes, pressures, and tempts you.

  • Fictional hacking-inspired gameplay using fake websites, terminal commands, response comparison, logs, CCTV, and safe toy systems.

  • Story choices with hidden consequences — the game tracks how reckless you become without showing morality meters.

  • Multiple endings based on how far you go and how much heat you create.

  • Cinematic apartment events including rent pressure, police attention, strange messages, and late-night consequences.

  • Dark, grounded atmosphere focused on loneliness, pressure, crime, and survival.

This is not a real hacking simulator. All systems, tools, websites, commands, and targets are fictional and built for story gameplay.
